copy.curiosityHook: Can an American courier and his mustang survive a grueling desert contest against elite rivals for a massive prize?
copy.description: In 1890, a Pony Express courier and his trusty horse, Hidalgo, journey across the ocean to Arabia to take part in a perilous, high-stakes endurance race across unforgiving desert terrain.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced and exciting, this sprawling historical adventure delivers active perils and contest momentum.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Joe Johnston, this cross-continental adventure blends classical Western grit with an epic racing contest built on sheer speed and perilous open-air stakes.

allowedMaterial: Pony Express courier and his horse Hidalgo
